findings.source_quote: They claimed that Scripture was being compromised to pacify the city council.
findings.suggested_fix: They claimed that Maandiko yalikuwa yakipotoshwa ili kuuridhisha baraza la jiji.
findings.translation_quote: Walidai kwamba Maandiko yalikuwa yakivunjwa ili kuuridhisha baraza la jiji.

findings.source_quote: because of his fiery disposition and skillful oratory abilities.
findings.suggested_fix: kwa sababu ya bidii yake yenye motomoto na uwezo wake wa kusema kwa ustadi.
findings.translation_quote: kwa sababu ya tabia yake ya uchangamfu na uwezo wake wa kusema kwa ustadi.

findings.source_quote: On September 6, he was burned at the stake along with a fellow minister.
findings.suggested_fix: Mnamo Septemba 6, alichomwa akiwa amefungwa kwenye nguzo pamoja na mhudumu mwenzake.
findings.translation_quote: Mnamo Septemba 6, alichomwa kwenye mti pamoja na mhudumu mwenzake.
